title: SAML interactive handshake verification and graceful fallback flow
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Implement an interactive SAML 2.0 handshake verification flow in the Console that validates incoming IdP metadata, performs live assertion probing, and offers deterministic graceful fallbacks for common metadata failures. This ticket covers frontend wizard screens, backend metadata parsing/validation service, audit event emissions, and RBAC gating so only org admins can finalize connectors.
acceptance_criteria: Admins can upload metadata URL or XML bundle and enter optional handshake test user attributes
Backend validates XML schema, signature presence, cert chains, and entityID uniqueness and returns a deterministic validation report within 6s for typical IdP files
Console surfaces a human-readable validation summary with categorized errors (Critical, Warning, Info) and recommended fixes
Wizard offers a one-click "Run handshake test" that attempts a passive SP-initiated AuthnRequest and reports SAML response status, assertion attributes, and clock-skew diagnostics

If metadata validation fails for recoverable reasons, the wizard provides guided fallback options (fingerprint pinning, manual entityID override, offline certificate bundle upload) and persists a safe provisional connector state until admin confirms
All configuration attempts, test runs, and finalizer actions emit audit events with tokenized admin identity and full validation verdict for compliance retention
RBAC: only users with the 'org.admin' role can complete the final enable step; other users may run tests in preview mode but cannot persist connector configs
technical_notes: Validation pipeline stages: basic XML schema -> SAML metadata heuristics (entityID, singleSignOnService endpoints) -> signature verification (support both enveloped and detached) -> certificate chain parsing -> temporal checks (validFrom/validUntil with 5m skew tolerance)
Use a worker-backed service (metadata-validator) to avoid blocking API requests; synchronous API returns preflight + job ID, then poll for detailed report
Signature verification: accept both SHA256 and SHA512 signatures; if signature absent, mark Critical unless the admin chooses fingerprint pinning fallback
Certificate rotation probe: when a cert chain is present, call cert transparency heuristics, check overlapping validity windows and warn if imminent expiration (<14 days)
EntityID normalization: trim trailing slashes and compare case-insensitively; if duplicate entityIDs across connectors, surface conflict and block finalization

Handshake test: spawn ephemeral SP session to send AuthnRequest to the IdP metadata SSO URL; verify SAML status, parse assertion attributes, verify issuer match and audience, and compute response latency
Telemetry: redact PII from assertions before storage; store attribute names and presence/absence flags for regression analysis
Fallback storage: provisional connector object is created with status 'provisional' and read-only to non-admins until approved; supports manual metadata edit and retry
ui_flow: Step 1: Choose metadata source -> URL, Upload XML, or Paste XML
Step 2: Quick preflight (fast checks) shows a pass/fail banner and top 3 issues if fail
Step 3: Detailed report (collapsible sections): Endpoints, Certificates, Signatures, EntityID, Validity Windows, Warnings
Step 4: Run handshake test -> modal shows live progress and captures response sample and timing
Step 5: If Critical failures -> show guided recovery options: upload cert bundle, pin fingerprint with note, override entityID only after confirmation
Step 6: Preview mode -> CLI-style sample assertion JSON (redacted) and summary for shareable troubleshooting
Step 7: Finalize -> admins can enable connector; non-admins presented with 'Request enable' that triggers an approval workflow
api_contract: POST /api/v1/saml/metadata/validate -> returns { job_id, summary_passed_boolean } immediately; GET /api/v1/saml/metadata/validate/{job_id} returns full report. POST /api/v1/saml/handshake/run with job_id triggers ephemeral SP test and returns test_id. GET /api/v1/saml/handshake/{test_id} returns test verdict. POST /api/v1/saml/connectors with "provisional" flag persists a provisional connector; PUT /api/v1/saml/connectors/{id}/finalize requires org.admin. All endpoints require audit-log context headers.
rollout_plan: Migrate validator worker into canary namespace and run with 10% of new wizard traffic
Feature-flag the provisional connector UI (ff: new_saml_handshake_flow) and enable for internal orgs first
Gather metrics for validation latency, false-positive rate, and admin acceptance rate over 2 weeks
Ramp to 100% after zero-severity security findings and <2% customer-reported failures during canary
testing_plan: Unit tests for XML parsing edge-cases (namespaces, multiple EntityDescriptor elements)
Integration tests against test IdPs (Okta, AD FS, OneLogin) using recorded metadata bundles
Chaos test: inject slow network and partial cert chains to verify fallback UIs and provisional state persistence
E2E in staging: run handshake tests with transient test users and assert audit events emitted and redaction applied
Manual security review: threat model for signature bypass, CVE checks on XML libs, and RBAC bypass attempts
risks_mitigations: Risk: False-negative signature failures for unusual IdPs -> Mitigation: allow fingerprint pinning with explicit admin acknowledgment and log it as high-risk audit event
Risk: Long-running validation for very large metadata bundles -> Mitigation: cap synchronous validation at 6s and continue in background with progressive UI updates
Risk: Storing sensitive assertion samples -> Mitigation: automatic redaction of PII and policy to retain only schema/attribute presence for 90 days
Risk: Non-admin users attempting to finalize connectors -> Mitigation: RBAC enforcement on finalize endpoint with explicit error event emitted
